row.name: Force Rage
row.effect: For 1 minute, you gain +2 ST, but suffer -1 to all Active Defenses. You must make a self-control roll to avoid attacking the nearest target (friend or foe).

levels.name: Force Rage
levels.description: The user channels their anger and pain into a terrifying surge of physical power, sacrificing defense for raw offensive capability.
